cases.title: Health / readiness probe
cases.objective: Verify /api/health reports ok only when the database is reachable.
cases.expected: HTTP 200 {status: ok, database: up} (test SQLite database).

cases.title: Frontend-to-backend endpoint contract
cases.objective: Parse every request in frontend/src/api/rtmApi.ts and verify a backend route exists with the same path and HTTP method.
cases.expected: All frontend RTM calls resolve to an existing FastAPI route (0 unmatched).

cases.title: Response shape matches the frontend Matrix type
cases.objective: Verify the matrix response contains every field the RTM Matrix page reads (types/rtm.ts Matrix / MatrixRow).
cases.expected: Top-level keys project_id, iteration_id, summary, rows; each row has requirement, story, AC, coverage and test fields.
cases.actual: Top-level keys: ['iteration_id', 'project_id', 'rows', 'summary']; missing row keys: none; test keys: ['description', 'id', 'source', 'status', 'title']

cases.title: Component 1 unavailable -> clear 503 error
cases.objective: Verify the RTM endpoints return HTTP 503 with an explanatory message (shown in the UI banner) when Component 1 is down.
cases.expected: Matrix, gaps, dashboard, inventory and portfolio -> 503 with 'Component 1' in detail.

cases.title: Component 2 unavailable -> graceful degradation
cases.objective: Verify the RTM still renders requirements (with no tests) when Component 2 is down, instead of failing the page.
cases.expected: Matrix HTTP 200; requirement rows present; total_tests 0; rows NOT COVERED.
cases.actual: HTTP 200; rows 1; total_tests 0; status NOT COVERED

cases.title: Missing required query parameters rejected
cases.objective: Verify project-scoped endpoints reject requests without project_id / iteration_id.
cases.expected: HTTP 422 for matrix, gaps, dashboard, inventory, portfolio when iteration_id is omitted.

cases.title: Model and dataset transparency endpoints
cases.objective: Verify model-info and dataset-info return the real trained-model report and dataset statistics used on the Quality Prediction page.
cases.expected: model-info: trained true, RandomForest, matches c2_quality_model_metadata.json; dataset-info: 1,000 rows, labels Low/Medium/High.
cases.actual: trained=True; algorithm=RandomForestClassifier (scikit-learn); accuracy=0.98; dataset rows=1000; labels=[{'label': 'Low', 'count': 467}, {'label': 'Medium', 'count': 202}, {'label': 'High', 'count': 331}]

cases.title: Quality predictions endpoint for a project
cases.objective: Verify every Component 2 test case of a project gets features, score, formula label and model label, using the linked ACs from Component 1.
cases.expected: One prediction per test case; requirement_linked = 1 when its story has ACs; labels within {High, Medium, Low}.

cases.title: Dashboard, inventory and portfolio consistency
cases.objective: Verify the dashboard, inventory and portfolio endpoints are built from the same matrix and agree with each other.
cases.expected: Dashboard quality buckets sum to matrix total_tests; inventory lists each test once with a quality score; portfolio flags the duplicate, the failing Must test and the vague test.
cases.actual: dashboard buckets=4, matrix tests=4; inventory=[('A', 'High'), ('B', 'High'), ('C', 'Medium'), ('D', 'Low')]; portfolio={'redundant': ['B'], 'critical': ['C'], 'weak': ['D']}

cases.title: Component 2 client: unreachable service raises a typed error
cases.objective: Verify the real Component 2 HTTP client converts connection failures into Component2Unavailable (pointed at a closed local port; Component 2 itself is not modified).
cases.expected: get_traceability_test_cases raises Component2Unavailable; is_reachable() returns False.
cases.actual: Raised: Component2Unavailable: Component 2 request failed (http://127.0.0.1:9/projects/P1/traceability): All connection attempts failed; is_reachable=False

cases.title: Component 1 client: unreachable service raises a typed error
cases.objective: Verify the real Component 1 HTTP client converts connection failures into Component1Unavailable.
cases.expected: get_requirements_with_stories raises Component1Unavailable; the external proxy endpoint returns 503.
cases.actual: Client raised Component1Unavailable; proxy endpoint -> HTTP 503

cases.title: Code-coverage analysis disabled safely
cases.objective: Verify POST /api/coverage/analyze returns 503 (no clone, no build) when COVERAGE_ENABLED=false, as in the test and Docker deployments.
cases.expected: HTTP 503 with 'disabled' in the detail; report endpoint still answers.
cases.actual: analyze -> HTTP 503: Code-coverage analysis is disabled in this deployment (the coverage runner toolc; report -> HTTP 200 status=IDLE

cases.title: Existing functionality unaffected by the testing component
cases.objective: Verify all pre-existing RTM routes are still registered after adding the testing endpoints.
cases.expected: All 17 pre-existing RTM route paths present in the application.
